name: Anker 555 USB-C Hub (8-in-1)
excerpt: Anker 555 USB-C Hub (8-in-1), Model A8383. Connects via USB-C. HDMI port supports up to 4K@60Hz (requires host support for DP 1.4). Supports up to 100W Power Delivery input, providing up to 85W high-speed pass-through charging while reserving 15W for hub operation. 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 ports (10 Gbps), Gigabit Ethernet.

evidence_excerpts.category: Anker classifies device as an 8-in-1 USB-C Hub.
evidence_excerpts.host_connection: Connects to host device through built-in USB-C cable.
evidence_excerpts.requires_usb_c_dp_alt_mode: Requires host device with USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode.
evidence_excerpts.hdmi_max_resolution: HDMI port supports resolution up to 4K (3840 x 2160).
evidence_excerpts.hdmi_max_refresh_hz: Supports refresh rate of 60Hz at 4K resolution.
evidence_excerpts.pd_input_max_w: Supports up to 100W Power Delivery input.
evidence_excerpts.pd_pass_through_max_w: Provides up to 85W pass-through charging to the connected laptop.
